rules.title: Prohibition on landlord use of algorithmic rent-setting devices (proposed SDMC Div. 11)
rules.requirement: Landlords may not use an algorithmic device that processes nonpublic competitor data to set rental rates or occupancy levels for residential rental property in San Diego. Each month and each property of use counts as a separate violation.
rules.key_value: Ban; civil penalties up to $1,000 per violation
rules.coverage_conditions: All landlords of residential rental property in the City of San Diego.
rules.exemptions: Excludes software that publishes reports from aggregated historical nonpublic competitor data more than 90 days old or from public information and does not recommend rates for future leases or renewals; excludes software used to set rents or income limits under local, state, or federal affordable housing program guidelines.
rules.penalty: Tenant civil action for injunctive relief, damages, or civil penalties up to $1,000 per violation; prevailing tenant recovers costs and reasonable attorney's fees; each month and each property is a separate violation.
rules.quoted_span:
(b) It is unlawful for a landlord to use an algorithmic device to set rental rates
or occupancy levels for residential rental property.
rules.conflict_note: Document is a February 27, 2025 staff report and draft ordinance (O-2025-107) with blank ordinance number and date of final passage; adoption is not shown. Ordinance would take effect on the thirtieth day after final passage. Status as of 2026-10-01 should be verified against the adopted ordinance.

rules.title: Prohibition on selling or licensing algorithmic rent-setting devices to landlords (proposed SDMC Div. 11)
rules.requirement: No person may sell, license, or otherwise provide to a landlord an algorithmic device that uses nonpublic competitor data to advise on or recommend rental rates or occupancy levels for San Diego residential rental property.
rules.coverage_conditions: Any person (software vendor) providing algorithmic devices to landlords regarding residential rental property in the City of San Diego.
rules.exemptions: Excludes software that publishes reports from aggregated historical nonpublic competitor data more than 90 days old or from public information and does not recommend rates for future leases or renewals; excludes software used to set rents or income limits under affordable housing program guidelines.
rules.penalty: Remedies under SDMC Chapter 1, Article 2 (judicial and administrative enforcement); tenant remedies under § 98.1104 apply to actions against landlords.
rules.quoted_span:
(a) It is unlawful for a person to sell, license, or otherwise provide an
algorithmic device to a landlord.
rules.conflict_note: Document is draft ordinance materials with blank ordinance number and passage date; adoption not shown. Effective 30 days after final passage if adopted. Verify adoption status.
